name: window-scenery
title_zh: 左下角永远钉着地名徽章的车窗风景照
tagline_zh: 坐在车里想发朋友圈，却总拍出反光玻璃和脏边框？它直接生成从车窗望出去的写实风景，每张左下角自动盖好地名徽章。
tagline_en: Tired of glare and dirty frames in your car-window shots? It renders photorealistic views from any vehicle, each.
desc_en: Generate photorealistic travel images from inside vehicles looking out through windows, with a consistent lower-left location badge. Use when the user asks for "车窗里的风景", "车窗美景", window-view scenery, travel photos from a car/train/boat/plane/cable-car window, or batch image prompts for locations viewed from transportation.
why_zh: 不是简单贴图，而是把车窗框、玻璃反光和窗外景深一起算出来，徽章位置固定，批量出图时风格统一得像同一台相。
why_en: It composites frame, glass reflections, and depth in one pass, with a fixed badge spot—so batch outputs look shot on the same.
limit_zh: 只认交通工具窗景（车/船/飞机/缆车），不生成窗外特写或人像；地名徽章仅限左下角，不能改位置；要真实地名需自备列表。
limit_en: Only vehicle-window scenery (car/boat/plane/cable car); no close-ups or people. Badge stays bottom-left. Real place names need your list—else it.
title_en: Window-view travel shots with a pinned location badge
